mapper.select: SELECT environment, system_code, module_code FROM tb_ai_log_module_config WHERE AND enabled = 1 AND sync_error_log = 1
SELECT system_code, module_code, sync_status, parse_status FROM tb_ai_log_file_record WHERE AND log_date = #{filter.startDate} AND file_type = 'ERROR'
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM tb_ai_log_ai_task_item WHERE analysis_task_id IN #{id} GROUP BY status
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_ai_log_ai_daily_report (environment, system_code, log_date, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{record.environment}, #{record.systemCode}, #{record.logDate}, 'WAITING', #{record.updateTime}, #{record.updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, environment, system_code, log_date, status, send_token, error_message, sent_time, update_time FROM tb_ai_log_ai_daily_report WHERE environment = #{filter.environment} AND log_date = #{filter.startDate} AND system_code = COALESCE(#{filter.systemCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '')
